meaning:
ἐν-πνέω, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Deu.20:16, Jos.10:28 ff. Jos.11:11, 14 (ptcp. neut., for נֶפֶשׁ, נְשָׁמָה), Wis.15:11 * ;]
1. to breathe on.
2. to breathe;
(a) absol.;
(b) with genitive part.: figuratively, ἀπειλῆς κ. φόνου, Act.9:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
